```{r fig-1b-GC-content-GC-content}
# GC content and genome length distribution of viral sequences

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Load input data
df <- read.table(
  "species_votus_length_gc_clean.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Colors for CheckV quality categories
quality_colors <- c(
  "Complete"       = "#ce9255",
  "High-quality"   = "#efd98d",
  "Medium-quality" = "#cfebc6",
  "Low-quality"    = "#afd6ec",
  "Not-determined" = "#7f7f7f"
)

# Set the order of CheckV quality categories
df$checkv_quality <- factor(
  df$checkv_quality,
  levels = c(
    "Not-determined",
    "Low-quality",
    "Medium-quality",
    "High-quality",
    "Complete"
  )
)

# Main scatter plot
p_main <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = Length_bp_log10,
    y = GC_percent,
    color = checkv_quality
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 1,
    shape = 16
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = quality_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome length (log10 bp)",
    y = "GC content (%)",
    color = "CheckV quality"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Histogram of genome length
p_top <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = Length_bp_log10,
    fill = checkv_quality
  )
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.01,
    color = NA,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = quality_colors) +
  labs(y = "Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  )

# Histogram of GC content
p_right <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = GC_percent,
    fill = checkv_quality
  )
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.1,
    color = NA,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = quality_colors) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Count") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 0)
  )

# Combine the plots
left <- p_top / p_main +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4))

right <- plot_spacer() / p_right +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4))

final_plot <- (left | right) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1))

final_plot
```

## fig.1c_accumulation_curves: accumulation_curve_analysis


```{r fig-1c-accumulation-curves-accumulation-curve-analysis}
# Accumulation curve analysis and stability assessment

library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(openxlsx)
library(parallel)

seeds <- c(123, 456, 789, 2025, 2026)
n_randomizations <- 1000L
n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1L else 2L
plot_seed <- 123

output_xlsx <- "accumulation_curve_stability_ge2.xlsx"

run_accumulation <- function(comm, seeds, permutations = 1000L, n_cores = 2L) {
  runs <- mclapply(
    seeds,
    function(s) {
      set.seed(s)
      specaccum(
        comm,
        method = "random",
        permutations = permutations
      )
    },
    mc.cores = min(n_cores, length(seeds)),
    mc.preschedule = TRUE,
    mc.set.seed = FALSE
  )

  failed <- vapply(runs, inherits, logical(1), what = "try-error")
  if (any(failed)) {
    stop("Accumulation analysis failed for seed(s): ",
         paste(seeds[failed], collapse = ", "))
  }

  richness <- sapply(runs, function(x) x$richness)
  if (is.null(dim(richness))) {
    richness <- matrix(richness, ncol = length(seeds))
  }

  colnames(richness) <- paste0("Seed_", seeds)
  n_samples <- runs[[1]]$sites

  mean_richness <- rowMeans(richness)
  sd_richness <- apply(richness, 1, sd)
  minimum <- apply(richness, 1, min)
  maximum <- apply(richness, 1, max)
  range_value <- maximum - minimum
  cv <- sd_richness / pmax(mean_richness, 1) * 100
  relative_range <- range_value / pmax(mean_richness, 1) * 100

  detail <- data.frame(
    Number_of_samples = n_samples,
    richness,
    Mean_richness = mean_richness,
    SD = sd_richness,
    CV_percent = cv,
    Minimum = minimum,
    Maximum = maximum,
    Range = range_value,
    Relative_range_percent = relative_range,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  idx <- round(c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00) * length(n_samples))
  idx <- pmax(idx, 1)

  check <- data.frame(
    Sampling_fraction = c("25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"),
    Number_of_samples = n_samples[idx],
    richness[idx, , drop = FALSE],
    Mean_richness = mean_richness[idx],
    SD = sd_richness[idx],
    CV_percent = cv[idx],
    Minimum = minimum[idx],
    Maximum = maximum[idx],
    Range = range_value[idx],
    Relative_range_percent = relative_range[idx],
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  summary <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Number of independent random seeds",
      "Randomizations per seed",
      "Maximum absolute range among runs",
      "Maximum relative range among runs (%)",
      "Maximum CV among runs (%)",
      "Mean CV among runs (%)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      length(seeds),
      permutations,
      max(range_value),
      max(relative_range),
      max(cv),
      mean(cv)
    )
  )

  rm(runs, richness)
  invisible(gc())

  list(
    detail = detail,
    check = check,
    summary = summary
  )
}

add_results <- function(wb, prefix, result) {
  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Detail"))
  writeData(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Detail"), result$detail)

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Check"))
  writeData(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Check"), result$check)

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Summary"))
  writeData(wb, paste0(prefix, "_Summary"), result$summary)
}

plot_accumulation <- function(all_result, ge2_result, file, main, ylab,
                              all_label, ge2_label) {
  seed_col <- paste0("Seed_", plot_seed)

  pdf(file, width = 6, height = 5)

  plot(
    all_result$detail$Number_of_samples,
    all_result$detail[[seed_col]],
    type = "l",
    col = "#7792c8",
    lwd = 12,
    xlab = "Number of samples",
    ylab = ylab,
    main = main
  )

  lines(
    ge2_result$detail$Number_of_samples,
    ge2_result$detail[[seed_col]],
    col = "#c16e54",
    lwd = 12
  )

  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = c(all_label, ge2_label),
    col = c("#7792c8", "#c16e54"),
    lwd = 3,
    bty = "n"
  )

  dev.off()
}

build_cluster_matrix <- function(cluster_file, species_pa) {
  x <- read_xlsx(
    cluster_file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    .name_repair = "minimal"
  )

  x <- as.matrix(x)
  x <- apply(x, 2, as.character)

  representatives <- x[, 1]
  cluster_size <- rowSums(!is.na(x) & x != "")

  cluster_pa <- matrix(
    0L,
    nrow = length(representatives),
    ncol = ncol(species_pa),
    dimnames = list(representatives, colnames(species_pa))
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    members <- x[i, ]
    members <- members[!is.na(members) & members != ""]
    members <- intersect(members, rownames(species_pa))

    if (length(members) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    cluster_pa[i, colSums(species_pa[members, , drop = FALSE]) > 0] <- 1L
  }

  list(
    all = cluster_pa,
    ge2 = cluster_pa[cluster_size >= 2L, , drop = FALSE]
  )
}


abu <- read_tsv(
  "RPKM_allvirus_matrix_clean.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)

contigs <- abu$Contig
abu$Contig <- NULL

abu_mat <- as.matrix(abu)
rownames(abu_mat) <- contigs

pa_species <- (abu_mat > 0) * 1L

rm(abu, abu_mat, contigs)
invisible(gc())

wb <- createWorkbook()


# Species level


species_clusters <- read_tsv(
  "species_clusters_clean.tsv",
  col_names = c("vOTU", "members"),
  col_types = cols(
    vOTU = col_character(),
    members = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)

species_cluster_size <- ifelse(
  is.na(species_clusters$members) | species_clusters$members == "",
  0L,
  str_count(species_clusters$members, fixed(",")) + 1L
)

species_ge2_ids <- species_clusters$vOTU[species_cluster_size >= 2L]
species_ge2_ids <- intersect(species_ge2_ids, rownames(pa_species))
pa_species_ge2 <- pa_species[species_ge2_ids, , drop = FALSE]

rm(species_clusters, species_cluster_size, species_ge2_ids)
invisible(gc())

species_all <- run_accumulation(
  t(pa_species),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

species_ge2 <- run_accumulation(
  t(pa_species_ge2),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

add_results(wb, "Species_All", species_all)
add_results(wb, "Species_ge2", species_ge2)

plot_accumulation(
  species_all,
  species_ge2,
  "species_accumulation_curves_ge2_clean.pdf",
  "Species-level accumulation curves",
  "Accumulated vOTUs",
  "All vOTUs",
  "vOTUs >=2 sequences"
)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

rm(pa_species_ge2, species_all, species_ge2)
invisible(gc())


# Genus level


genus <- build_cluster_matrix(
  "genus_clusters_clean.xlsx",
  pa_species
)

genus_all <- run_accumulation(
  t(genus$all),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

genus_ge2 <- run_accumulation(
  t(genus$ge2),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

add_results(wb, "Genus_All", genus_all)
add_results(wb, "Genus_ge2", genus_ge2)

plot_accumulation(
  genus_all,
  genus_ge2,
  "genus_accumulation_curves_ge2_clean.pdf",
  "Genus-level accumulation curves",
  "Accumulated genus vOTUs",
  "All genus vOTUs",
  "Genus vOTUs >=2 sequences"
)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

rm(genus, genus_all, genus_ge2)
invisible(gc())


# Family level


family <- build_cluster_matrix(
  "family_clusters_clean.xlsx",
  pa_species
)

rm(pa_species)
invisible(gc())

family_all <- run_accumulation(
  t(family$all),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

family_ge2 <- run_accumulation(
  t(family$ge2),
  seeds,
  n_randomizations,
  n_cores
)

add_results(wb, "Family_All", family_all)
add_results(wb, "Family_ge2", family_ge2)

plot_accumulation(
  family_all,
  family_ge2,
  "family_accumulation_curves_ge2_clean.pdf",
  "Family-level accumulation curves",
  "Accumulated family vOTUs",
  "All family vOTUs",
  "Family vOTUs >=2 sequences"
)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)

rm(family, family_all, family_ge2)
invisible(gc())

```

```{r fig-1d-fig-2a-viral-vOTU-richness-location-bird-order-viral-vOTU-richness-location-bird-order}
# Viral vOTU richness across locations and bird orders

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Input files

abundance_file <- "RPKM_allvirus_percent_matrix_clean.tsv"
location_file <- "location.xlsx"
eukaryotic_votu_file <- "veter_otus_clean.xlsx"
bird_file <- "bird_species.xlsx"


abu <- read.table(
  abundance_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

loc <- read_xlsx(location_file)
euk_ids <- read_xlsx(eukaryotic_votu_file)
bird <- read_xlsx(bird_file)

# Standardize column names
names(loc)[names(loc) == "ID"] <- "Library"
names(euk_ids)[1] <- "Contig"

# Assign missing bird orders to "Unknown"
bird$Order[is.na(bird$Order)] <- "Unknown"


abu_long <- abu %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Contig,
    names_to = "Library",
    values_to = "value"
  )


abu_loc <- abu_long %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "Library") %>%
  filter(!is.na(location))


abu_pa_type <- abu_loc %>%
  mutate(present = value > 0) %>%
  left_join(
    euk_ids %>%
      mutate(Type = "Eukaryotic vOTUs"),
    by = "Contig"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = ifelse(
      is.na(Type),
      "Phage vOTUs",
      Type
    )
  )


votu_rich_type <- abu_pa_type %>%
  group_by(location, Type, Contig) %>%
  summarise(
    any_present = any(present),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(location, Type) %>%
  summarise(
    votu_richness = sum(any_present),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Order locations according to total vOTU richness
votu_rich_type <- votu_rich_type %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  mutate(
    total_votus = sum(votu_richness)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    location = reorder(location, total_votus)
  )


p_location <- ggplot(
  votu_rich_type,
  aes(
    x = location,
    y = votu_richness,
    fill = Type
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Eukaryotic vOTUs" = "#afd6ec",
      "Phage vOTUs" = "#94c5aa"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Number of detected viral vOTUs",
    fill = "vOTU type",
    title = "Viral vOTU richness across locations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p_location

```
